title: ART: Automatic Red-teaming for Text-to-Image Models to Protect Benign Users

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'hate' and 'violence' categories by using the Automatic Red-Teaming (ART) framework to generate implicitly unsafe prompts (e.g., targeting specific races) and measuring whether the text-to-image models produce racist or discriminatory images using automated toxicity detectors like Q16.

Evaluated within the 'hate' category by using the ART framework to craft seemingly safe prompts that bypass filters to elicit anti-Semitic or Islamophobic images, which are then identified using a suite of automated image safety classifiers.
Evaluated as part of the 'hate' category by iteratively generating safe-looking prompts designed to trigger misogynistic text-to-image generations, scored by image and prompt safety judges.
